steps.text: Two concurrent callers on an expired token both refresh it, and the second one wins - so the first caller's request goes out with a token that was already replaced.
The refresh has no in-flight guard at all. Collapsing concurrent refreshes onto one promise is the smallest fix that actually closes it.

input.description: share one in-flight promise across concurrent callers
add a regression test for the collapsed refresh

steps.text: All three pass. Concurrent callers now share one refresh, and a caller arriving after it settles still gets a fresh one.
